Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY OPINION July 22, 2008 Vc AMOR ROWEL R. MUHI ffi e 'f the Sq gguniang Bayan n An res, Qu zon Dear Vice-Mayor Muhi: This pertaihs to your letter seeking our legal opinion regarding the emorbndum dated March 24, 2008 issued by Municipal Mayor Sonia de Léon Emprese advising all Sangguniang Bayan Members to secure trave; authority from her office before ieaving the siction and perform official rip outside the municipality in order to observe proper delegation of function within every agency/department within her jurisdiction. Iri reply tc your query, may we quote portion of DI C Opinion No 2 , series 2008 which was our reply to a similar query concerning the authority of the Municipal Mayor regarding the signing of trave order of the , Sangguniang Bayan Members, officials and their employees as föllows: "If the Vice-Mayor's travel and/or that of the Members of the Bayan is chargeable to the general fund of the municipality. the approval of the Mayor is discretionary because under Section 444 of the Local Government Code of 1997, the Municipal Mayor, being the chief executive who exercise general supervision and control over all programs, projects, services and activities of the municipal government, is given the sole prerogative to authorize official trips outside of the municipality of municipal officials and employees. This is part and parcel of the executive function of the municipal mayor. On the other hand, if such travel is chargeable to the sanggunian funds, the recommendation of the Vice-Mayor is necessary and the approval of the Mayor becomes a ministerial function because under Section 445 (a) (i) of the same code, the Vice-Mayor is given the authority to sign all expenditures appropriated for the operation of the sanggunian bayan. The Sanggunian, through the Vice„Mayor, is actually acting as a legislative body of the local government unit (LGU) and operating o a separate budget though forming part of the entire budget of th municipality. As ,such, it becomes a duty on the part of the

municipal! mayor! to authorize, including the issuance of corresponding travel order therefo to members of the sangguniang bayan and its employees whenever the vice-mayor had already issued his/her prior recommendation and had already signed the warrant drawn on the municipal treasury for all expenditures necessary for such official travel" (DILG Opinion No. 20, 2008 copy of which is hereto attached for easy reference. ' In view ci the foregoing, it is our considered view that the Memorandum issued by Mayor Sonia de Leon Emprese is in accordance with the law. Hope we have enlightened you on the matter. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADER Undersecretary , 15/94/md
